summary: Builds a small pop-up card that appears when the mouse hovers over a trigger element, with a fixed width, border, and shadow.
purpose: Shows extra detail about an item on hover, without a click.
why: Likely reason: a hover preview is a common pattern for quick detail. The code does not state the exact reason.
how: It imports the hover card library and style helper. It sets the root and trigger to the library parts. The content card is centered by default, sits a small gap from its trigger, and has a fixed width. It is exported at the end.
inputs: The trigger element, the content placed inside, alignment and gap overrides, and standard element settings.
outputs: A hover-only preview card. Nothing is stored.
risks: The card only appears on hover, so it should not hold anything a user must act on. Touch screens may not show it at all.
debug: If the card does not appear, check the trigger element and the screen code. If it sits in the wrong place, check the alignment and gap defaults here.
